text: This bank's bad loans fell by more than half in ninety days.
Clue one. Suryoday Small Finance Bank. Bad loans, six point five percent in June. Two point nine percent in September.
Clue two. In the same quarter, it wrote off five hundred and ninety one crore of loans.
The twist. Put the write off back, and bad loans are about six point six percent. Right where they were in June.
And provisions cover just thirty one percent of what's left. Cleaner book, or cleaner number? Back to the napkin.
